0022600110.text: Denver hosts New Orleans with both teams at 0-1: the Nuggets sit 9th in the West and 4th in the Northwest, 1.5 games back, while the Pelicans are 8th in the West and 3rd in the Southwest, 1 games back. The Nuggets won all three meetings in the 2025-26 season 3-0, and the most recent game was a 122-116 Denver win in New Orleans on January 13, 2026, while the 2026-27 season series has no games yet. Denver is missing Cameron Johnson (ankle sprain), Julian Strawther (knee sprain) and Spencer Jones (hamstring), all listed as out, and Alpha Diallo (wrist) is day-to-day and a game-time decision.
